question: On open boards a designer routed by hand, does Copper (the router HS hands boards to) match the designer when given the same placement?
method: scripts/routing_reference_benchmark.py: strip tracks, vias and copper zones from the designer's 2-layer board, route with Copper (Freerouting 2.2.3 plus its finisher, GND poured), and run KiCad 10.0.8's DRC on both boards. Vias on the designer's boards include stitching vias.
result: 1 of 3 matches the designer: SNAP Power Controller is DRC-clean with 12 vias against 39 and 14% more track. IP5328P leaves 2 connections unrouted. PiUPS routes every connection but adds 7 shorts and 30 solder-mask bridges, with 42% more track. Automatic routing is not at a designer's level on 2 of these 3 boards.
limits: Three 2-layer boards; Copper's settings as shipped; no 4-layer board was tried (Copper's pour step is 2-layer).
